cases.title: Select available seat and verify count and total price update
cases.description: Click on an available seat (without the occupied class) to mark it as selected, and verify that the selected seat count in data-testid="selected-count" updates and the total price in data-testid="total-price" correctly reflects the product of selected seats and the movie price.

cases.title: Attempt to select an occupied seat
cases.description: Click on a seat marked with the occupied class and verify that it remains unselectable and does not affect the selected seat count or total price.

cases.title: Change selected movie from dropdown and verify total price update
cases.description: Select a movie from the dropdown with data-testid="movie-select" and verify that changing the selected movie dynamically updates the total price based on the new movie's ticket price.

cases.title: Select a movie from dropdown and verify price update
cases.description: Verify that users can select a movie from the dropdown menu (identified by specific data-testid) and its price updates accordingly based on options like 'The Big Lebowski ($10)', 'Fargo ($12)', 'O Brother ($8)', and 'No Country for Old Men ($9)'.

cases.title: Toggle available seat selection and update localStorage and UI
cases.description: Verify that clicking on an available seat (e.g., identified by data-testid="seat-1-1") toggles its selection status, visually marks it, stores its indices in localStorage, and updates the seat count (data-testid="selected-count") and total price (data-testid="total-price").

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as 'occupied' cannot be selected or included in the calculation.

cases.title: Deselect previously selected seats
cases.description: Verify that users can deselect previously selected seats by clicking on them again, and the UI, along with localStorage, updates accordingly.

cases.title: Restore State from Local Storage
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the webpage when local storage contains 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', the corresponding seats are marked with the 'selected' class and the movie dropdown is set to the correct option.

cases.title: Default State when Local Storage is Empty
cases.description: Verify that when local storage does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', no seats are marked as 'selected' and the movie dropdown defaults to the first movie option, 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Select movie, click available seats, verify count and total price
cases.description: Verify that selecting a movie and clicking available seats updates the selected count (data-testid="selected-count") and total price (data-testid="total-price") correctly.

cases.title: Deselect a previously selected seat
cases.description: Verify that clicking a selected seat again deselects it, decreasing the selected count and total price accordingly.

cases.title: Change movie selection after selecting seats
cases.description: Verify that changing the movie selection after seats are already selected updates the total price based on the new ticket price while maintaining the count of selected seats.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that clicking on seats marked as occupied does not select them or alter the selected count and total price.

cases.title: Verify seat status legends and interactions
cases.description: Verify that users can distinguish between available, selected, and occupied seats through legends, occupied seats are non-interactive, available seats can be clicked to toggle selection, and the count and total price update accordingly.

opinions.feedback: The provided test cases are well-structured, distinct, and directly derived from the requirements without introducing blockers or unsupported speculations.
All test cases are well-structured, directly mapped to the requirements, and cover both normal flows and edge cases without redundancy or unsupported behaviors.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1 describes multiple distinct behaviors including seat selection toggling, occupied seat restriction, selected seat counting, movie dropdown selection, and dynamic total price calculation based on seat count and movie price. Scenario types covered: Normal, Edge, Boundary, Abnormal/Error. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2 describes multiple distinct behaviors including selecting movies with specific data-testids, toggling seat selection status, storing indices in localStorage, updating seat count and total price, preventing occupied seat selection, and deselecting seats. Scenario types covered: Normal, Edge, Boundary, Abnormal/Error. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3 describes multiple distinct behaviors including retrieving keys from localStorage ('selectedSeats', 'selectedMovieIndex'), applying selected classes and dropdown states, and handling cases where local storage lacks these values (defaulting to the first movie). Scenario types covered: Normal, Edge, Boundary. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4 describes multiple distinct behaviors including movie selection, toggling seat selection, updating selected count and total price, deselection handling, movie change recalculation, and preventing selection of occupied seats. Scenario types covered: Normal, Edge, Boundary, Abnormal/Error. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5 describes multiple distinct behaviors including distinguishing seat statuses via legends, non-interactive occupied seats, clicking available seats to toggle, and updating count and total price. Scenario types covered: Normal, Edge, Abnormal/Error.
